Rank 6; optimisation. RANK 6 (tier 1: computationally characterised). CDRH3 WGGDGFYAMD->WGGMGPYWMD (3 subs, 3/4 crystal-contact residue identities retained). Latest independent contact evidence: 3/3 strict epitope-contact samples in matched framework experiment; minimum recall 0.9474.
